status: Owner-authorized Task20 development. Final scope before implementation; only actual tests may establish TESTED, never RELEASED.
limit_policy: Provisional starting limits, requiring browser measurements and boundary tests during separately authorized development.

candidates.name: Excel Formula Generator
candidates.primary_functionality: Guided deterministic SUM, AVERAGE, COUNT, COUNTA, MIN, MAX, IF and ROUND templates; validated references, escaped literal strings, comma/semicolon argument separators, explanations and examples. Generates formulas without evaluating them. Distinct from Excel Sandbox structural inspection.
candidates.dependencies: No added runtime library; existing shared consent and Tailwind setup retained.
candidates.proposed_limits: At most 20 arguments; 8 KiB total UTF-8 input; each literal <=256 code points; formula output <=4 KiB. Reject invalid references and external-workbook references.
important_tests: Independent expected formula fixtures for all eight operations
Comma/semicolon argument separation
Quote and sheet-name escaping
Empty, invalid, boundary and Unicode input
No formula evaluation or input transport
Copy/reset/error invalidation and keyboard/mobile behavior
candidates.known_limitations: English function names; no arbitrary natural-language/AI interpretation, calculation, or automatic translation of Excel function names and locale decimal conventions. The registry L rating is retained; initial scope is deliberately limited.

candidates.name: Emoji Picker
candidates.primary_functionality: Search a pinned local Unicode emoji dataset by English accessible name and category; copy exact sequences; offer only dataset-valid presentation and skin-tone variants.
candidates.dependencies: Review and pin Unicode emoji-test data, its exact license, provenance and hash. Bundle data locally; use platform glyphs without third-party emoji image/font requests.
candidates.proposed_limits: Bundled data <=1 MiB; search <=100 code points; render at most 100 results per page; copied sequence <=32 code points. Confirm dataset coverage before fixing limits.
important_tests: Pinned dataset license/hash and unique sequences
Names and category search
ZWJ families, flags, variation selectors and valid skin-tone variants
Exact clipboard sequence preservation
Keyboard navigation, focus after filtering, accessible names and copy denial
Zero input-dependent external requests
candidates.known_limitations: Appearance and glyph availability depend on the OS/font. English names initially; newer emoji can display as missing glyphs. Never fabricate modifier combinations.

candidates.name: Image Compressor
candidates.primary_functionality: Target-byte/quality workflow with side-by-side preview, actual before/after byte counts and explicit JPEG/WebP output. Retain the original and report no improvement when encoding is larger or the target is unattainable. This extends beyond the existing converter's single quality-controlled conversion.
candidates.dependencies: Existing bounded JPEG/PNG/WebP header-validation patterns and native browser encoders; no new runtime codec.
candidates.proposed_limits: One static image <=5 MiB, <=4096 pixels per side and <=8 million pixels; at most 12 encoding attempts within 10 seconds; output <=8 MiB. No silent resizing.
important_tests: Actual MIME/signatures and independent output decoding
Before/after bytes and honest no-improvement result
Feasible and impossible target sizes
Transparency and explicit JPEG background
Input/header/pixel/output bounds
Cancellation/reset, stale results and bitmap/object-URL cleanup
candidates.known_limitations: Lossy quality varies by browser; no guaranteed exact target, globally optimal quality or lossless PNG optimization. Re-encoding can change metadata/color handling. If limited to duplicating the converter's quality slider, do not create a separate utility.

candidates.name: PNG to ICO
candidates.primary_functionality: Produce a multi-size ICO using a reviewed local PNG-frame encoder. Offer 16, 32, 48, 64, 128 and 256 pixel images, preserving alpha and aspect ratio through explicit transparent padding.
candidates.dependencies: Review the bounded ICO encoder against Microsoft format documentation and independent consumers. No production package selection or encoder approval is made by this plan.
candidates.proposed_limits: One static PNG <=5 MiB, <=4096 pixels per side and <=8 million pixels; maximum six frames; output <=1 MiB.
important_tests: Independent ICO directory, offsets, sizes and 256-pixel zero-byte fields
Decode every embedded PNG and compare dimensions/alpha
Open output with an independent Windows icon consumer
Non-square padding, duplicate sizes and malformed PNG
Input/output caps, reset and cleanup
candidates.known_limitations: Initial PNG-frame ICO scope targets modern compatible consumers, not legacy BMP-only icon editors. Scaling is not hand-tuned icon artwork. Keep the registry L rating until encoder and compatibility tests pass.

candidates.name: Resume Builder
candidates.primary_functionality: Accessible structured section/item editing and reordering, safe preview, browser print layout, explicit JSON draft import/export and optional HTML export. No automatic draft persistence.
candidates.dependencies: Use the existing static framework and print patterns; no PDF-rendering library, remote fonts or account service.
candidates.proposed_limits: At most 10 sections and 50 items; total text/draft input <=50 KiB UTF-8; generated HTML <=250 KiB. Plain text fields only initially.
important_tests: Section add/remove/reorder and keyboard focus
Literal rendering of markup and unsafe URL rejection
Validated JSON round trip and unknown-field rejection
Print pagination, long words and narrow layouts
Explicit import/export/reset, no autosave or input transmission
candidates.known_limitations: PDF saving uses the browser print dialog. Pagination/fonts vary across environments; no ATS or employment-outcome guarantee. No rich-text editor, photo upload or cloud drafts in the initial scope.

candidates.name: Passport Photo Layout Maker
candidates.primary_functionality: Arrange copies of one local portrait at user-defined millimetre dimensions on A4/Letter sheets. Provide explicit fit/padding, margins/gaps, PNG export, print layout and a physical scaling/calibration guide. Refer manual cropping to the existing Image Cropper.
candidates.dependencies: Native image/print APIs and existing bounded image patterns. No face service, official-requirement database or PDF library.
candidates.proposed_limits: One static JPEG/PNG/WebP <=5 MiB and <=8 million input pixels; tile dimensions 10-100 mm; at most 40 tiles; A4/Letter sheet at 150/300 dpi and <=10 million output pixels; PNG <=40 MiB.
important_tests: Independent mm-to-pixel arithmetic, rounding and tile coordinates
Exact sheet dimensions and tile count
Aspect/padding, margin/gap and sheet-fit validation
PNG signatures/MIME and pixel positions
Print CSS/calibration guide, input/output bounds, keyboard/reset and cleanup
candidates.known_limitations: Printer/browser scaling must be calibrated. No face/pose/background validation or guarantee of official document acceptance. No silent stretch/crop or automatic jurisdiction-specific rules.

selection_notes: Reviewed all 30 registry PLANNED entries, including required features, dependency gates, complexity and related tools; selected scopes checked against actual released source.

Hashtag Counter overlaps Hashtag Organizer counts/extraction; Social Media Line Break Tool overlaps existing bio/text formatting; Decision Wheel needs a distinction beyond the current crypto-backed list picker.
PDF/workbook parsers, minifiers, hostile HTML/SVG conversion, password estimation, EXIF and encryption require additional dependency/security feasibility gates; defer them for a focused later batch.
All six proposals retain static browser-local processing and no paid dependencies. Dataset/encoder review remains mandatory; proposed limits are not measured performance claims.

If all six are subsequently authorized, implemented and publicly released, the count would reach 68, leaving seven tools before the 75-release planning checkpoint. No further work is authorized by that arithmetic.
